description:

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet’s Platform teams build and operate systems that enable customers to access and analyze Planet's daily and high resolution imagery, as well as derived products like Basemaps. We enable customers to browse data catalogs, stream data via tile services, and orchestrate geospatial analysis.

  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently, navigate uncertain and sometimes ambiguous problem spaces, and take calculated risks
  • Experience working with diverse data storage systems such as relational databases, document stores, and key-value stores
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
  • Experience with Git, large codebases, reviewing merge requests, and running complex CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfortable working with Docker containers
  • Solid intuition of when AI is useful in softwa

About the Role:  

At Planet, we launch spacecraft early and often. From technology demonstrators to operational constellations, exceptional engineers are needed to design, manufacture, test and launch spacecraft. This role offers a unique opportunity for an engineer to take ownership of environmental testing activities supporting spacecraft production and delivery.

As a Senior Spacecraft Qualification Engineer, you will serve as the primary mechanical and environmental test engineering authority at our Berlin manufacturing site. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on work and thrives in ambiguity, with deep technical expertise, quick engineering judgment, and the ability to independently assess and resolve complex test situations while ensuring the safety of personnel and flight hardware. Coming from a dynamic aerospace environment, having completed challenging environmental test campaigns while collaborating effectively with R&D, systems, and manufacturing teams will be a solid advantage.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in our Berlin office 5 days per week. Occasional travel should be expected as part of testing and integration operations.

Impact You’ll Own:

Own environmental test execution and respond to off-nominal events: 

  • Review environmental test requirements, procedures, and readiness packages for spacecraft acceptance and protoflight campaigns.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority during test operations including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and thermal vacuum test operations.
  • Perform hands-on operations including instrumentation setup, inspections, test monitoring, and hardware troubleshooting.
  • Assess test data in real time to identify failures, anomalies, or unexpected hardware responses.
  • Develop and implement technically sound recovery plans while preserving personnel safety, facility safety, and hardware integrity.

Ensure test readiness and facility capability:

  • Validate test configurations, instrumentation plans, facility readiness, and hardware constraints prior to test execution.
  • Coordinate with technicians and cross-functional teams to ensure safe and efficient execution of environmental test campaigns.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Supervise and assist with procurement, machining, assembly and proofloading operations of test fixtures and Ground Support Equipment (GSE).

Drive measurement and test data analysis: 

  • Configure and validate data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and test monitoring tools.
  • Analyze environmental test data to evaluate hardware performance, determine compliance, identify anomalies, and recommend next steps.

Implement continuous improvement and process development:

  • Improve environmental test processes, procedures, facility capabilities, and operational efficiency and reliability.
  • Develop practical solutions to recurring technical challenges and contribute to long-term reliability of environmental test operations.

Document and develop communication: 

  • Generate clear test reports, anomaly investigations, and engineering recommendations based on environmental test results.
  • Provide technical guidance to technicians and advise spacecraft, systems, manufacturing, and quality teams on environmental test matters.
  • Develop close communication and working relationships with Engineering and Manufacturing teams. Participate in technical reviews, program status meetings, etc.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Thermal Engineering or Electro-Mechanics/Robotics Engineering. 
  • Experience owning vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and thermal vacuum test campaigns for flight or flight-like hardware.
  • Understanding of environmental verification methodologies, acceptance  and protoflight testing industry standards, and flight hardware handling.
  • Knowledge of spacecraft systems and the interactions between structures, mechanisms, avionics, payloads, and thermal systems.
  • Knowledge of structural dynamics and vibration theory (resonance and modal behavior, wave propagation, random vibration, boundary control, etc.).
  • Knowledge of heat transfer principles and thermal management technology. 
  • Ability to evaluate test data, identify anomalies, assess risk, make sound engineering decisions during off-nominal situations, and develop recovery plans for flight hardware.
  • Proficiency in using Solidworks CAD & FEA (simulation) or equivalent. 
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing competing priorities and tight schedules.
  • Ability to lead a team of technicians and work closely with international engineers in a collaborative environment.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Hands-on experience (portfolio submission encouraged).
  • Experience in operating a variety of test machines as vibration shakers, thermal chambers, TVAC chambers, shock machine, as well as working with test equipment such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Experience building and working with DAQs for test article command/control and data gathering; well-versed with the instrumentation, usage, and data consumption from accelerometers, load cells and other DAQ sensors.
  • Interest in prototyping, rapid iteration and agile processes. Experience in working in a machine shop.
  • Interest in automation. Familiarity with Raspberry Pis, Node Red, or Python.

description: Location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida / Fully Remote (U.S.) Pinewood.AI is looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead Developer to play a key role in growing our software development capabilities in the United States. Based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida , this is an exciting opportunity to join a growing global engineering organization and take a leading technical role in the continued development of the Pinewood Automotive Intelligence Platform, our enterprise-scale SaaS platform used by automotive retailers and OEMs around the world. Fort Lauderdale is the preferred location for this role, but we are open to fully remote candidates anywhere in the U.S. where their seniority, technical expertise, and overall experience are an exceptional match for the position. As a senior member of the engineering organization, you will lead and support a team of developers and senior engineers, helping shape technical decisions, guide delivery, and establish high standards for engineering excellence. This role is ideal for a strong technical leader who enjoys staying hands-on with code, developing people, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape the engineering practices of a growing organization. Key Responsibilities Lead and provide day-to-day technical direction to a team of software developers and engineers. Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams across the U.S. and internationally to deliver high-quality features and enhancements for the Pinewood Automotive Intelligence Platform. Remain hands-on with coding, software design, and architecture, promoting engineering best practices across the full .NET stack. Mentor and coach developers and senior engineers, helping them strengthen their technical capabilities and progress in their careers. Ensure the team delivers scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions that meet enterprise SaaS standards. Help shape engineering processes, development standards, CI/CD pipelines, and technical practices as the U.S. engineering organization grows. Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to long-term technology and system design decisions. Promote strong communication and collaboration across geographically distributed engineering and product teams. Diagnose complex technical issues, conduct code reviews, and lead the resolution of challenging engineering problems. Help build a positive, collaborative, and high-performing engineering culture. Balance technical leadership with hands-on development, remaining close to the code and actively contributing to delivery. Requirements Proven experience as a Lead Developer, Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior engineering role within a SaaS, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology environment. Strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, and SQL / T-SQL . Solid understanding of database design, performance optimization, and query tuning. Experience delivering front-end functionality using HTML, JavaScript, and Razor . Practical experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps , or equivalent cloud and CI/CD technologies. Proficiency with Visual Studio and/or VS Code . Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, security, and modern software development practices. Experience leading, mentoring, or developing other engineers, with the ability to lead through both technical expertise and influence. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working effectively across distributed teams and multiple time zones. Ability to make sound technical decisions while balancing engineering quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities. Experience in the automotive, enterprise SaaS, or other complex/high-availability software environments is highly desirable. Desirable Experience Experience helping establish, grow, or scale a new engineering team or technical function. Previous experience working within a globally distributed engineering organization. Experience working on large-scale, business-critical SaaS platforms. Experience with cloud-native development and modern software engineering practices. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Why Join Pinewood.AI? This is an opportunity to take a leading technical role in the growth of Pinewood.AI's engineering capabilities in the United States. You'll work with experienced engineering and product teams across the U.S. and internationally, contribute directly to a globally trusted SaaS platform, and have a meaningful influence on the technical direction, engineering standards, and culture of a growing organization. Whether you're based in Fort Lauderdale or working remotely elsewhere in the U.S. , you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while remaining hands-on with technology. If you thrive in a technical leadership role where you can write code, influence architecture, mentor engineers, solve complex problems, and drive meaningful product impact , we'd love to hear from you. About Pinewood.AI Our story began more than 20 years ago, rooted in the specific needs of the automotive industry. From the beginning, we combined automotive expertise with technology to build practical solutions designed around how automotive businesses actually operate, recognizing what makes the industry unique. Today, Pinewood.AI is an Automotive Intelligence Platform that enables automotive retailers, dealerships, and OEMs to drive growth and profitability across their businesses. Our secure, cloud-based, end-to-end ecosystem helps customers unlock the value of their data and make better commercial and business decisions more easily. Our vision is to be the full-service technology partner for automotive retailers and OEMs, helping them operate more efficiently, increase revenue, and make better-informed decisions through technology and intelligence. description: Job Summary: We build and maintain the systems that government motor vehicle agencies depend on to test, license and certify drivers. Our software runs in production across more than two dozen jurisdictions in the United States and Canada, where reliability and auditability are contractual obligations rather than aspirations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build and maintain data-intensive enterprise applications across that portfolio. The majority of this work is in C# and .NET , backed by SQL Server . Our front ends vary: some applications are built entirely in Vue.js , one of our primary applications uses Vue selectively, and another uses none at all — so you will move between modern component-based front ends and traditional server-rendered views. Some of our highest-throughput components are written in C++, so working proficiency there — or the appetite to develop it — matters, but .NET is where most of your time will be spent. Success requires strong problem-solving skills, comfort moving across mixed technology stacks, and genuine ownership of delivering reliable solutions in real production environments. You will work in systems that carry years of accumulated business logic, and you will help modernize them without disrupting the jurisdictions that rely on them daily. Duties and Responsibilities: Design, build and support web applications and services using C# and .NET MVC Design and optimize SQL Server queries and data access patterns for high-performance transactional systems, with emphasis on query efficiency, indexing strategy and minimizing latency Contribute to front-end development across a mixed estate — Vue.js applications, partial Vue adoption, and traditional server-rendered views Maintain and extend core application logic in C++ where our highest-throughput components require it Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues spanning database, backend and UI layers Work within and improve complex legacy systems while maintaining production stability Contribute to ongoing modernization efforts across legacy and current platforms Deliver jurisdiction-specific change requests and configuration work to committed dates Collaborate with QA, Product and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality releases Participate in code reviews and help raise development standards Support automated testing and CI/CD pipeline improvements Mentor engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team Education and Experience: Strong professional experience with C# and .NET, building and maintaining production web applications and services Strong experience with SQL Server, including query design and optimization, performance tuning and efficient data access patterns Strong object-oriented design skills, with a working commitment to SOLID principles and the judgment to apply them pragmatically in existing code Experience with systems where performance and reliability are critical to business operations Working proficiency in C++, sufficient to read, debug and modify existing production code, with the willingness to deepen it. We do not expect a C++ specialist, but you will encounter it. Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Vue.js, or the ability to pick one up quickly, alongside comfort working in traditional server-rendered front ends 5–8 years of professional software development experience Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other engineers Experience in complex, multi-system or legacy-integrated environments Experience with modern AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot Experience modernizing legacy systems or working in hybrid environments Experience with mobile development frameworks such as React Native Experience with UWP Experience in regulated or compliance-driven environments, for example PCI Experience working with government or public-sector customers Experience with CI/CD pipelines, including building and maintaining automated build and release workflows Azure cloud development experience, including cloud architecture and deploying and operating services in Azure Deeper C++ experience in production systems Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Ability to debug complex issues across multiple layers — database, backend and UI Proven ability to design and implement maintainable, scalable systems Strong collaboration across engineering, QA and product teams Ability to take ownership of deliverables and drive work to completion Ability to understand existing systems quickly and make safe, incremental improvements in production We are looking for an object-oriented developer in the fullest sense: someone who designs with SOLID principles in mind and writes code that others can safely change.
